publish.title: Publish an event
publish.intro: Free for all verified accounts. Five steps, autosaved draft, published immediately or after review depending on your trust level.
publish.loginFirst: Log in or create an account to get started.
publish.rules: An event is approved if it is public or open on registration, takes place at a real date and venue, has an understandable title and description, does not promote illegal activities and is not disguised advertising.
publish.comingSoon: The publication form ships in sprint 4. The API is already available (POST /api/v1/events).

about.title: About WIGO
about.text: WIGO, for “Where I Go?”: the question “Where am I going today?”. A Brussels platform to discover and publish events, in French, Dutch and English, run by Genius Harmony.
